subject: chest
text: A chest down the first rope ladder in the Cave to Glasdar Tower contains an ex bomb.

evidence.quote: Go down the rope ladder and open the chest for an ex bomb.

subject: chest
text: A chest inside the west door past the second rope ladder contains a black ring.

evidence.quote: Enter the west door to find a chest containing a black ring which you may want to equip.

subject: chest
text: A chest to the east outside the west door contains ex arrows.

evidence.quote: Back out the door, open the chest to the east for ex arrows.

subject: toxic marsh
text: Searching the toxic marsh reveals a hidden power potion.

evidence.quote: Search the toxic marsh for a hidden power potion and then head east where you'll find two doors.

subject: floor panels
text: Entering the south door leads to floor panels that restore HP and MP.

evidence.quote: Enter the south door first and step on the HP and MP restoring floor panels.

subject: chest
text: Going up the rope ladder past the north door leads to a chest to the east containing a stone cure.

evidence.quote: Go up the rope ladder and open the chest to the east for a stone cure.

subject: chest
text: Entering the door at the junction with a door and a ladder leads to a chest containing a hi magic.

evidence.quote: Enter the door first and open the chest for a hi magic.

subject: chest
text: Entering the door up the rope ladder leads to a chest containing sonic heels.

evidence.quote: Now go up the rope ladder and enter the door up there. Open the chest for sonic heels and the go through the next door.

subject: chest
text: A chest through the next door contains a smoke ball.

evidence.quote: Open the chest for a smoke ball.

subject: chest
text: A chest through the subsequent door contains a hi potion.

evidence.quote: Enter the door and open the chest for a hi potion.

subject: chest
text: Going down the next two rope ladders leads to a chest containing an antidote.

evidence.quote: Go down the next two rope ladders and open the chest for an antidote.

subject: chest
text: Climbing up the really long rope ladder and the next ladder brings you to an eastern door with a chest containing a great potion.

evidence.quote: Walk east and go up the really long rope ladder and the next rope ladder as well. Enter the door to the east and open the chest for a great potion.

subject: chest
text: The chest east of the door contains a miracle.

evidence.quote: Open the chest east of the door for a miracle.

subject: chest
text: Going down the rope ladder reveals a chest containing a gloom arrow.

evidence.quote: Go down the rope ladder and open the chest there for a gloom arrow.

subject: chest
text: Climbing up the westernmost rope ladder leads to a chest containing a mind gourd.

evidence.quote: Go back up, walk west, and take the western most rope ladder up. Open the chest for a mind gourd.

subject: chest
text: Heading west and climbing the rope ladder leads to a chest containing a dragon arrow.

evidence.quote: Walk west, go up the rope ladder, and open the chest for a dragon arrow.

subject: chests
text: Entering either of the two doors leads to two chests containing a big arrow and an ex potion.

evidence.quote: Go up the east rope ladder and enter the door. Enter either of the two doors you should see now and then open the two chests for a big arrow and an ex potion.

subject: chest
text: Climbing the west rope ladder leads to a chest containing an ex bomb.

evidence.quote: Go up the west rope ladder next and open the chest for an ex bomb.

subject: chest
text: Going up the rope ladder east of the ladder leading to a door and continuing east reveals a chest containing ex arrows.

evidence.quote: Go up the rope ladder east of it and continue east to find a chest containing ex arrows.

subject: chests
text: Entering the door up the ladder leads to two chests containing miracles and a hidden miracle in the toxic marsh.

evidence.quote: Go up the rope ladder there and enter the door. Open the two chests for miracles, and search the toxic marsh for another hidden miracle.

subject: Cave to Glasdar Tower
text: Unlocking the door, stepping on the warp pad, climbing the rope ladder, and taking the stairs leads directly outside Glasdar Tower.

evidence.quote: Unlock the door and step on the warp pad. Go up the rope ladder, take the stairs up, and we'll find ourselves right outside Glasdar Tower.

subject: chest
text: Entering the west door leads to a chest containing a hi potion.

evidence.quote: Enter the west door and open the chest for a hi potion.

subject: chest
text: Entering the east door leads to a chest containing an ex bomb.

evidence.quote: Then enter the east door and open the chest there for an ex bomb.

subject: chest
text: Taking the stairs past the north door and entering the east door leads to a chest containing a big arrow.

evidence.quote: Next enter the north door and take the stairs up. Enter the door to the east and open the chest for a big arrow.

subject: chest
text: Heading north, through the door, and east through two doors leads to a chest containing ex arrows.

evidence.quote: Head north and enter the door there. Walk east and enter the next door. Walk east again and enter the door to find a chest containing ex arrows.

subject: chests
text: Following the south path up the stairs and entering the east door leads to two chests containing a mind gourd and a power gourd.

evidence.quote: Next follow the south path and go up the stairs. Enter the door to the east first and open the two chests for a mind gourd and a power gourd.

subject: chest
text: Entering the west door leads to a chest containing a revive.

evidence.quote: Enter the door to the west next and open the chest for a revive.

subject: chest
text: Entering the north door and the next door leads to an east chest containing another revive.

evidence.quote: Now enter the north door. Walk in either direction and enter the next door you see. Open the chest to the east for another revive.

subject: chest
text: Entering the south door, taking the stairs up, and entering the next door leads to a chest containing an ex bomb.

evidence.quote: Then enter the door to the south, go up the stairs, and enter the next door. Open the chest for an ex bomb.

subject: chest
text: Entering the door south of the eastern progression door leads to a chest containing a gloom arrow.

evidence.quote: The door to the north leads nowhere. The one to the east will take us to the next floor but don't enter it yet. First enter the door south of it and open the chest there for a gloom arrow.

subject: chests
text: Entering the door south of the gloom arrow and the subsequent door leads to two chests containing a gloom ring and a miracle.

evidence.quote: Enter the door south of it and then the next door as well to find two chests. Open the for a gloom ring and a miracle.

subject: chest
text: Backtracking and entering the east door and next two doors leads south to a chest containing an antidote.

evidence.quote: Backtrack and enter the east door and the next two doors as well. Walk south and open the chest for an antidote.

subject: warp pad
text: Stepping on the warp pad behind the east door leads to HP and MP restoring floor panels.

evidence.quote: Enter the east one first and step on the warp pad to reach HP and MP restoring floor panels.

subject: room with ten chests
text: Entering the next three doors past the switch room leads to a room with ten chests containing a spell potion, power potion, mind potion, great potion, speed potion, revive, and 4 miracles.

evidence.quote: Enter the next three doors and you'll come to a room with ten chests. Open them for a spell potion, power potion, mind potion, great potion, speed potion, revive, and 4 miracles.

subject: Nazeby
text: The boss on the southern circle of the top floor can be defeated by using physical attacks with all four characters, having Lufia or Jerin cast boost once silence wears off.

evidence.quote: Make sure all of your characters are fully healed before stepping on the southern circle. This is the easiest boss fight yet. Use physical attacks on him with all four of your characters. He'll probably silence your magic users but by the time you need to heal, it should have worn off. When it does, simply have Lufia or Jerin cast boost while the rest of your characters continue with the physical attacks.

subject: Dragon Eggs
text: The second set of dragon egg locations includes Alekia's Castle, Belgen, top floor of Northwest Tower, Cave Southwest of Belgen, Cave Northeast of Tower of Light, Elba Island Cave, Under Ring Island, and Oil Cave.

evidence.quote:
First we have to collect the eggs for the second time....1. Alekia's Castle...2. Belgen...3. Northwest Tower (On the top floor)...4. Cave Southwest of Belgen (down the stairs that have a door to the west and
more stairs to the east)...5. Cave Northeast of Tower of Light...6. Elba Island Cave (Down the three rope ladders and all then all the way west)...7. Under Ring Island (In the West Cave)...8. Oil Cave (Go down the first set of stairs, then cross the bridge, and follow
the path)

subject: Dragon
text: Returning to the Dragon Shrine after collecting the second set of dragon eggs lets you make a wish, with the might shield recommended.

evidence.quote: After collecting them, return to the Dragon Shrine and wish for something. I recommend getting a might shield this time.

subject: Dragon Eggs
text: The third set of dragon egg locations includes Sheran Castle Throne Room, East Cave, Old Cave 7th floor, Lyden, Cave East of Herat, Cave North of Glasdar Tower, Cave to Glasdar Tower, and Glasdar Tower.

evidence.quote: Now we can collect the eggs one more time....1. Sheran Castle (In Throne Room)...2. East Cave ...3. Old Cave 7th floor...4. Lyden...5. Cave East of Herat (Up the south eastern most rope ladder)...6. Cave North of Glasdar Tower (Flip the switch up and step on the warp pad)...7. Cave to Glasdar Tower...8. Glasdar Tower (In the room with ten chests)

subject: Dragon
text: Returning to the Dragon Shrine after collecting the third set of eggs lets you make your final wish, where another might shield is recommended.

evidence.quote: After collecting them, return to the Dragon Shrine for your final wish. I recommend getting another might shield.

subject: Doom Island
text: Warping to Arus and flying northwest into Doom Island lets you land on the circle and enter the Fortress past the old man.

evidence.quote: Warp to Arus and fly northwest into Doom Island. Land on the circle. Enter the door to the north and then the next door. Walk north and speak to the old man. Then enter the door to the north. Continue north, go up the steps, and enter the Fortress.

subject: chest
text: Entering the west door in the Fortress leads to a chest containing a power potion.

evidence.quote: Enter the door to the west and open the chest for a power potion.

subject: chests
text: Following the path and entering the door reveals three chests containing a speed potion, mind potion, and great potion.

evidence.quote: Follow the path and enter the door to find three chests. Open them for a speed potion, mind potion, and great potion.

subject: chest
text: Walking around to the east and going up the stairs leads to a chest containing a spell potion.

evidence.quote: Walk around to the east and go up the stairs. Open the chest for a spell potion and then go through the door.

subject: chest
text: Heading north, up the stairs, and entering the east door leads to a chest containing a power potion.

evidence.quote: Head north and take the stairs up. Enter the door to the east and open the chest for a power potion.

subject: chest
text: Entering the door at the eastern end and taking the west door leads to a chest containing a spell potion.

evidence.quote: Walk east and enter the door when you reach the end. Enter the door to the west and open the chest for a spell potion.

subject: chests
text: Walking around to the north before climbing the steps reveals two chests containing two miracles.

evidence.quote: Don't go up the steps yet. First walk around to the north and open the two chests there for two miracles.

subject: floor panels
text: Taking the steps on the intermediate level leads to HP and MP restoring floor panels.

evidence.quote: If you want walk around and take the steps on that level to reach HP and MP restoring floor panels.

subject: chests
text: Entering the door at the top of the flight of stairs leads to three chests containing three miracles before crossing the bridge.

evidence.quote: Enter the door but don't cross the bridge yet. First walk around and open the three chests for three miracles.

subject: Gades
text: Gades attacks only one party member at a time; have Jerin heal the targeted ally while Hero and Aguro concentrate on attacking.

evidence.quote: Gades can only attack one of your party at a time. Have Jerin heal the last person he attacked, while Hero and Aguro concentrate on attacking.

subject: Amon
text: Amon attacks the entire party with magic and can inflict confusion; counter by having Lufia heal using boost while Hero and Aguro attack.

evidence.quote: When you walk further you'll battle Amon. Amon uses magic which attacks your entire party so have Lufia heal using boost, while Hero and Aguro attack. He may confuse some of your characters, so be prepared.

subject: Daos
text: Daos requires the same combat strategy as Amon, along with preparation to heal paralysis.

evidence.quote: The move forward to battle Daos. Be prepared to heal paralysis and use the same strategy for Daos as you did Amon.

subject: final battle
text: In the final battle following Daos, Hero and Aguro attack while Lufia and Jerin cast boost, beating the game despite confusion effects.

evidence.quote: After defeating Daos you'll go directly to the final battle. Hero and Aguro should attack as usual. Lufia and Jerin should cast boost. Your characters will be confused a couple time during this battle but they usually tend to attack the boss anyway. After winning the battle... Congratulations on beating the game. Enjoy the ending.

subject: switches
text: Stepping on the middle and east switches takes you to a room with a chest containing a miracle.

evidence.quote: Stepping on the middle and east switches takes you to a room with a chest containing a miracle.

subject: switches
text: The switch surrounded by carpeting resets the switches after taking the long way back.

evidence.quote: Unfortunately we can't warp back to the switches, so get back to them the long way, and reset them by stepping on the one surrounded by carpeting.

subject: switches
text: Stepping on no switch takes you to a chest containing a miracle, but forces you to work back up from the first floor.

evidence.quote: If you step on no switch it will take you to a chest containing a miracle but then you'll have to work your way back up from the very first floor.

subject: switches
text: Stepping on just the east switch takes you to a chest containing a stun arrow, requiring you to climb back up from the first floor.

evidence.quote: If you step on just the east switch you'll be taken to a chest containing a stun arrow. You'll also have to work your way back up from the very first floor for this... if you really want it.

subject: switches
text: Stepping on just the middle switch allows you to proceed through two doors and upstairs to the top floor.

evidence.quote: Whether you decided to get the last two items or not, step on just the middle switch when you are ready to proceed. Enter the next two doors and then take the stairs up.
